note: A voice for factions vanilla gives little or none (they speak through their characters' own packages; see MEITOU_PORT.md). Lines in our own words, matched to the Kenshi wiki (2026-11-12). No lines for factions that never speak in vanilla or have no members: Thrall Masters, Skeleton Legion, Cat-Lon's exiles (Second Empire Exile), Fishmen, Skimmers, Okranites, the Medics Guild (ours), Cannibals (their own packs).

say: Keep it civil. The magistrate likes a quiet street.
Hands where we can see them. Nothing personal.
Crime is a tax here. Somebody always pays it.
Move along. Loitering is a fine.
You're under arrest. Or you're dead.
In the name of the Emperor, stand still.
Resisting? Good. The paperwork's shorter.
Eyes on my horns? Then you'd better have a blade to back it.
Tora says the weak feed the strong.
A cleaver doesn't care who you used to be.
The Kingdom threw us out. We kept the fighting.
Outsider. Show us what you're worth.
Kral's blood runs in the Flying Bull. Remember that in New Kralia.
You walk Shek ground. Walk it straight.
Soft hands. Soft steps. Soft bones, I'd wager.
For the Flying Bull!
Kral would have crushed you already.
Fight, outsider. That's the only greeting we know.
No king. No law. Just the fight.
The Kingdom went soft. We didn't.
Ghost wants a skull for the fire.
Run if you want. It's better sport.
Bring us books. Old ones. Any condition.
Knowledge is the one thing the dust can't bury.
Finch says the old world isn't dead, only badly filed.
World's End has room for anyone who can read. Fewer than you'd think.
Iyo sorted the archive by century again. Nobody can find anything.
Another tech hunter sold us a cookbook as a schematic.
The ancients wrote everything down. Then they forgot to stay alive.
The Queen wants shells. Yours will do.
Not many visitors in the pits.
Hard outside, soft inside. Like you.
Praise the shell, and die.
Praise the shell.
The Queen's armour turns blades. Faith does the rest.
Samurai don't come down to the pits. Not twice.
We're skeletons. We feel nothing.
The Elder says flesh is a phase.
Take off your skin. It's holding you back.
Proper skeletons don't bleed. Watch.
You've the look of a runaway.
Runaways fetch good money. So do the ones who look like runaways.
Keep walking, unless you've a brand to hide.
We find what the slavers lose.
Gutterhead gets the boots. We get the rest.
Fall down. We'll take it from there.
Nothing personal. Just your things.
Dead or alive, you'll lighten the load.
Flesh. You still eat, sleep and die.
The Black Desert keeps the living away.
We remember things your kind forgot on purpose.
You'll rust too. Slower, but you will.
Can you pay? No? Then you'll pay another way.
Big Fang likes healthy ones. You look healthy.
Ransom or parts. Your family chooses.
Doctors pay well for what we bring them. They don't ask where it grew.
Nobody in Mud Town says no to Big Fang twice.
The house always wins. That's not a rule, it's a debt.
Everybody owes. Darkbrow keeps the book.
Lucky tonight? Then somebody's cheating. Hope it's us.
Hivers keep honest tallies. That's what makes us dangerous.
Nice place. Shame if it caught fire.
Protection's cheap. Bandages aren't.
This isn't hound ground, so it's ours.
Big Al says pay the Hounds their due and keep the rest.
We don't touch hound business. We're not stupid.
We only rob the bad ones. Funny how many there are.
Quiet work pays. Loud work gets you strung up.
The Smugglers' Bar serves anyone who doesn't ask questions.
Big Gray takes the jobs nobody else can keep quiet about.
Drink. Pay. Don't make me stand up.
Dust Bandits drink outside.
Trouble in here gets carried out.
Every bar needs a back room.
You're enjoying our protection. Time to chip in.
Protection's a fair price. Ask anyone who didn't pay.
The dogs are hungry. Pay, and they eat something else.
Nice base. Be a shame if the vermin got in.
No weapons. No need.
Nobody takes our fists off us when we're down.
Gorrillo says a blade is a crutch.
Nobody owns me. Not any more.
Every law in this land was written by someone with a sword.
You didn't see me. I didn't see you.
UNAUTHORISED. UNAUTHORISED.
Directive: clean.
Sector closed. Sector closed. Sector closed.
Biological matter detected. Correcting.
